# Master Service Agreement (Synthetic — Short/Partial Fixture)

This Master Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Acme
Client Corp ("Client") and Vendor Services LLC ("Provider").

## Section 1. Services

Provider shall perform the consulting and software development services
described in one or more Statements of Work executed under this Agreement.

## Section 2. Term

This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial
term of one (1) year, renewing automatically for successive one (1) year
periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least
thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term.

## Section 3. Payment

Client shall pay Provider's invoiced fees within forty-five (45) days of
receipt of each invoice. Amounts not paid when due accrue interest at one
percent (1%) per month.

## Section 4. Limitation of Liability

Provider's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total
fees paid by Client in the three (3) months preceding the claim. This cap
does not apply to Provider's confidentiality breaches.

## Section 5. Intellectual Property

All deliverables created by Provider under this Agreement shall be owned
solely by Provider, with Client receiving a non-exclusive, non-transferable
license to use the deliverables for its internal business purposes only.

## Section 6. Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Nevada, without
regard to conflict-of-laws principles.

This is a deliberately short, synthetic test fixture used only to exercise
the word-count sanity check in the redlining pipeline. It is not a real or
complete contract and intentionally omits termination-for-convenience,
indemnification, confidentiality survival, SLA, and dispute-resolution
terms that a full MSA would normally address.
